evidence: Wrote 5 new tests first. 5 failed, 4 old ones passed. Implemented --records in scripts/session_report.py. `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_session_report.py` gives 9 passed. One of my own test expectations was wrong (s2 total is 2, not 3) and I corrected it before the final run. Real run `timeout 300 python3 scripts/session_report.py --records > /tmp/sa/real_records.jsonl` took 4.10 s and wrote 247 lines. All 247 rows have a records key. 8 sessions have records.total > 0. 553 records are attached in total. 386 of those are ambiguous. No transcript or record content was printed.
observations: The high ambiguous share (386 of 553) means the project-name plus time-window join overlaps heavily when sessions run in parallel or overlap in the same project. Without --records, rows still stream and print as before, and the reader is never called. Output holds no ids and no record bodies. Rows with an error key get no records key.
